tips.text: Level it on Salacia, Neptune (Archwing Mobile Defense); it takes 3 to 4 solo runs with no booster.
Stack an affinity booster, a relay affinity blessing or a double-affinity weekend before leveling it.
Bring Amesha so its Benevolent Decoy guards the objective while you kill.
Buy it when you have the Ducats and credits; it can be half a year before it returns.
Crack relics in a full squad of four and take the highest-Ducat reward.
Bring a second unleveled Arch weapon so objective XP is not wasted on a maxed one.
Have a friend nuke spawns on Elytron while you sit safe on Amesha; shared affinity levels the Archmelee without swinging it.
Buying it is easy; leveling an Archmelee is the part players dislike.
Most players buy it purely for the 3,000 Mastery.
